title: IpcRequestValidator
responsibility: Validate desktop bridge requests before dispatch.

inputs.name: IpcRequestValidator.parse.channel
inputs.description: A known typed desktop bridge channel.

inputs.name: IpcRequestValidator.featurePlanPayload.input
inputs.description: Untrusted prepareFeaturePlan payload. Accepts the exact project, source revision, original user request, proposal with wanted contracts/tasks, and per-page committed reference plus optional normalized edit region; rejects unknown top-level and nested keys.

outputs.name: IpcRequestValidator.parse
outputs.description: Returns the channel-specific validated payload. Feature preparation preserves the distinct original request and validates the project/source binding, proposal and exact per-page reference/region records before desktop dispatch; feature-plan actions validate their project, feature, digest and selected option or reviewer.
